name: FieldError
summary: An error message under one control or one group: a danger icon and words that say how to fix the value, linked to the control through aria-describedby.
useWhen: A value that fails a check on blur or on submit, under the control it belongs to
The error part of a Field, through the error prop or as a child
An error for a group of choices, under a Fieldset
avoidWhen: A problem with the whole form or the page, such as a failed save
A hint that helps fill the control before anything is wrong
A result that needs no fix, such as Saved

size.description: md is font.size.s with the 16px icon, the error of a Field. sm is font.size.xs with the 12px icon, under a small control.

id.description: Alone, the id the control's aria-describedby points at. Inside a Field the Field gives it.

children.description: The message. Nothing renders when it is empty.

a11y.role: paragraph, with no role attribute: never role alert and never a live region
a11y.focus: Never focusable. On submit the form moves focus to the first invalid control, which reads the error.
a11y.announce: Read with the control through aria-describedby when focus lands there. The control carries aria-invalid. Inside a Field both are wired while the error renders.
notes: Never color alone: a danger icon and words. The icon is aria-hidden; the words carry the meaning.
Not a live region and never role alert: an error that is on the page when it loads must not interrupt, and a screen reader reads it with the control.
Rendered only when there is an error, so it has no state attributes. invalid false on the Field hides it.
Validate on blur or on submit, never on every key.
Inside a Field the Field's error id wins over an id passed in. An empty string renders nothing, like no message.

en.message: Says how to fix it, in plain words: Add the part after the @, for example name@example.com. Never only Invalid, Error or Required.
en.tone: Calm and specific. No blame, no exclamation marks, no codes.

ar.message: يقول وش يسوي عشان يصلحها: البريد ناقص، اكتبه كامل. مو بس غلط أو مطلوب
ar.tone: هادي وواضح، بدون لوم وبدون علامات تعجب
ar.latin: النص اللاتيني داخل العربي يمر عبر Bidi

react.behavior: hand built, reads the Field context
react.note: No motion: the message appears and leaves at once, so the layout does not move under the pointer. There is no pattern to name and nothing to reduce.

angular.behavior: p[dsFieldError], host bindings, reads the dsField context
angular.note: The host paragraph is the root. Inside dsField it takes the error id and registers with the field while it exists. React renders nothing for a FieldError without children; an Angular host cannot leave the DOM by itself, so the caller wraps it in @if (the one line error input of dsField does that and follows invalid false).

native.behavior: react-native:Text with a danger icon, linked with accessibilityHint on the control
native.note: React Native has no aria-describedby: the control reads the message as its hint.

styles.studio: color.state.danger.text for the icon and the words, text s
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: An error that only says Invalid email
mistakes.right: An error that says how to fix it: Add the part after the @, for example name@example.com

mistakes.wrong: role alert on an inline error that is there when the page loads
mistakes.right: FieldError, read through aria-describedby when focus lands on the control
FieldError, which starts with the danger icon

mistakes.wrong: A FieldError with no aria-describedby on the control and no Field around it
mistakes.right: An id on the FieldError and aria-describedby plus aria-invalid on the control, or a Field

mistakes.wrong: An error that shows on every key while the person types
mistakes.right: Check on blur or on submit
